claim: The InventoryEditor mod obtains the current player as *(*(engine singleton 0x1426ffa98)+0x888) and reads the player world position as three floats at player+0x2180/0x2184/0x2188, although GameOffsets.h marks that engine singleton as UNVERIFIED.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. Offsets are hardcoded file RVAs (no pattern scan, no version gate), so any mismatch with 1.0.8874.0 would silently hook wrong code.
verification_method: Static read of repo. Could be checked against our build only by static RE of xrefs to 0x1426ffa98 and +0x888 uses; no runtime reading in Phase 1.
limitations: Internal contradiction: the same singleton is labeled UNVERIFIED/garbage-yielding for the pause chain but used for the player pointer. Only position is mapped; no rotation, velocity, health or controller.
next_experiment: Static RE in our exe: find code reading [singleton]+0x888 and confirm the target type via RTTI/vtable (repo claims Character base vtable 0x141f995e0).
